description: This file implements the AampEventListener class, which handles various playback-related events for the AampMediaStream and communicates these events to a parent object via SendEvent calls. It includes event handling methods for start, progress, state change, buffering, speed change, and failure events, utilizing JsonObject to format event details.

classes.name: AampEventListener
classes.description: Listener class responsible for handling AAMP playback events and forwarding formatted event data to a parent object.

methods.name: Event
methods.description: Main handler that delegates events to specific processing functions based on event type.

methods.name: HandlePlaybackStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles the playback started event and notifies the parent.

methods.name: HandlePlaybackStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Processes playback state change events and sends the new state.

methods.name: HandlePlaybackProgressUpdateEvent
methods.description: Handles progress updates during playback, sends timeline info.

methods.name: HandlePlaybackFailed
methods.description: Handles playback failure events with error details.
